title: Meeting Held By The "China Anti-British And Anti-American. Association"

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY No. 1440 Date 27/2/42）

S. 1 Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date February 25. 1942....

SUBJECT: Meeting held by the "China Anti-British and Anti-American Association".

Between 1 p.m. and 3 p.m. February 24, the "China Anti-British and Anti-American Association" (中華民族反英美協會) held a meeting on the 2nd floor parlour of the Park Hotel, No. 164 Bubbling Well Road. About 400 persons attended. Chow Peng Ching (周邦俊), Manager of the Great China Dispensary, who was presiding over the meeting, delivered a speech on the significance of the meeting. Following this, Chen Ya Fu (陳亞夫), representative of the Wharf Coolies Mutual Aid Association, who was a member of the Presidium, made a report relating to the preparatory matters of the meeting. 25 members of the Standing Committee were elected, and the regulations of the Association were passed. Sung Shao Kong (孫紹康), President of the Shanghai Second Special District Court, and Zee Ji Ling (徐乾麟), Chief of local benevolent societies, declared that Britain and America had carried out aggression against China, and that the Japanese Army has now eliminated Britain and America and emancipated China, so as to bring about Sino-Japanese friendship. Then the Commander of the Japanese Army delivered a speech. Finally, a dinner party having taken place, the meeting terminated.

The Association was promoted by the following three organizations :-
1) The Wharf Coolies Mutual Aid Association (碼頭勞工互助會) with an office on North

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别班登记处 第1440号 日期 1942年2月27日）

S. 1 特别班分站。档案号.................... 日期 1942年2月25日....

事由：“中华反英美协会”举行的会议。

2月24日下午1时至3时，“中华反英美协会”（中華民族反英美協會）在南京路164号国际饭店二楼客厅举行会议。约400人出席。主持会议的大华药房经理周邦俊发表了关于会议意义的演讲。随后，主席团成员、码头劳工互助会代表陈亚夫作了关于会议筹备事项的报告。会议选举产生了25名常务委员，并通过了协会章程。上海第二特区地方法院院长孙绍康和地方慈善团体首领徐乾麟宣称，英美对中国实施侵略，而日军现已扫除英美势力，解放中国，以实现中日亲善。随后，日军指挥官发表演讲。最后，在举行晚宴后，会议结束。

该协会由以下三个组织发起：
1) 码头劳工互助会（碼頭勞工互助會），办事处位于北
